name: Echart
description: This project contains two components for visualizing data from the Wine Data Set using React and ECharts for React. The Line Chart component displays the relationship between "Flavanoids" and "Ash", while the Bar Chart component displays the minimum "Magnesium" value for each "Alcohol" category.
